channel.title: J K Fertilizers - Blog & Insights

item.title: PROM vs DAP: Chemical Mechanisms, Soil Phosphorus Fixation, and Agronomic Economics
item.description: A technical comparison of Phosphate Rich Organic Manure (PROM) versus Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP), examining calcium phosphate precipitation kinetics, organic acid chelation, and fertilizer economics in alkaline soils.

item.author: info@jkfertilizers.com (J K Fertilizers)
